title: Vantage Anomaly Alert
description: An Anomaly Alert that monitors a Cost Report for unexpected cost spikes based on a percentage threshold.

token.description: The unique token identifier for the Anomaly Alert.

cost_report_token.description: The token of the associated Cost Report.

threshold.description: The threshold percentage for anomaly detection.

created_at.description: The date and time the Anomaly Alert was created.
